title: TVS Motor’s Venu Srinivasan says India must bridge quality gap to make ‘Made in India’ a mark of trust
excerpt: India's manufacturing sector must focus on quality and innovation to secure a competitive global position. title: KKR-owned Healthium, Temasek-backed Romsons in race to buy 70-80% stake in BL Lifesciences
excerpt: KKR-owned Healthium Medtech and Romsons Group are reportedly competing to acquire a significant stake in BL Lifesciences. The company is expected to be valued between ₹1,800 and ₹2,000 crore during this stake sale. KPMG is providing advisory services to the promoters of BL Lifesciences for this transaction, which involves a family-owned business. BL Lifesciences specializes in various medical devices for surgeries, critical care, and more.

title: 'AI raises the floor, people raise the ceiling': PwC US CEO on India venture, Big Four race and GCC push
excerpt: In a bold move to enhance global integration, PwC is merging its Indian consulting operations with its US counterparts. This monumental shift, led by Sanjeev Krishan, will unite around 40,000 professionals in a shared mission focused on artificial intelligence and technology investments. Expected to rake in $1.5 billion in initial revenue, this merger marks a significant trend in the consulting industry, prioritizing advanced technology integration and local-global collaboration.
